chapter_title: Concerning the Gathering in of the [E]lements.

2.original: [the Pillar of Glory to the First Man, the Man to the Ambassador, the Ambassador to]
2.content: the Pillar of Glory to the First Man, the Man to the Ambassador, the Ambassador to

spiritual_reading:
Wisdom will be drawn back into love, and love itself will be drawn back into the understanding that receives it; and that understanding will be drawn back into the more interior power that gives it motion; and that power will be drawn back into the general sphere that contains and orders it; and that containing sphere will be drawn back into the clear perception that can reply from truth; and that reply will be drawn back into the governing influx that calls and disposes all things.

This governing influx will be directed into the mind purified from falsity and disorder, which is the truly intellectual level. The truly intellectual level will be drawn into the fixed support of Divine manifestation; that support into the first formed heavenly person; that heavenly person into the mediating office that conjoins higher and lower; and that mediation into the entire expanse of the Divine realm in its greatness.

Such is the order of their re-uniting; yet this complete re-uniting will occur only once, and then all that has been thus gathered will be raised into an eternal state of peace, beyond further conflict or dispersal.

fills.fill: the Pillar of Glory to the First Man, the Man to the Ambassador, the Ambassador to
fills.notes: The sequence here must continue the inward-to-outward reversion through the hypostases that mediate ascent: purified Mind (intellectual) → Pillar of Glory (fixed support and manifested column) → First Man (first formed heavenly human, archetypal form) → Ambassador (mediating office that conjoins higher and lower) → aeons of greatness (the whole expanse of the Divine realm). This matches the correspondential order given in the spiritual translation and preserves the impersonal cosmological register of the oldest layer without importing later devotional framing.

assessment: This chapter has a single lacuna, and the surrounding correspondential chain uniquely constrains its content: it is the standard ascent sequence from Mind through Pillar, First Man, and the mediating Ambassador into the aeons. Restoration is therefore tight and effectively certain.
